title: myn-blob — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins protocol::encode_new_note_blob_raw + protocol::decode_note byte mapping for the MY01 per-note blob format. Three case kinds: 'encrypt' (encoder byte output across plaintext sizes), 'decrypt_ok' (round-trip success), 'decrypt_aead_fail' (non-distinguishing AEAD-stage rejection per spec §6.4). Content-type is HARDCODED to 'text/markdown' in v0.1 (bound into aad_note_content_encrypt) — no per-vector variation parameter. Spec contract: docs/spec/protocol.md §9.2 + §6.4 + §6.5.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'myn-blob/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: encrypt — pin the encoder's byte output across plaintext sizes

input_plaintext_hex.description: Plaintext bytes (hex). Variable length up to MAX_PLAINTEXT_LEN (16 MiB) — vectors cover 10 B / 1 KB / 100 KB representative sizes.

expected_myn_blob_hex.description: Full MY01 blob (header_prefix + content_nonce + ciphertext_len_be32 + ciphertext + CTX tag). Length = 76 + plaintext.len() + 32 bytes.

oneOf.title: decrypt_ok — pin the decoder's successful round-trip

expected_plaintext_hex.description: Recovered plaintext bytes (hex). The decode_note caller compares its DecryptedNote.plaintext() output byte-equal.

oneOf.title: decrypt_aead_fail — pin the non-distinguishing AEAD-stage failure surface

expected_kind.description: Rust reference returns Err(DecryptError::CannotDecrypt) — single non-distinguishing variant per spec §6.4. Ports MUST NOT distinguish wrong-key / wrong-AAD / tampered-ciphertext / tampered-tag beyond a single 'cannot decrypt' outcome at the caller-visible surface.
